Class CabinsManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.client.CabinsManager
public class CabinsManager extends Object
Manages the cabins and crew placement on the player's ship during the game. It allows the player to assign crew members to specific cabins, respecting the alienability of each cabin, and keeps track of the modified cabins.

This class interacts with the LightPlayer's shipboard, validating the crew assignments and ensuring that only compatible crew members are placed in each cabin.

  • Constructor Details

    • CabinsManager

      public CabinsManager(LightPlayer lightPlayer, DisplayableView view)
      Constructs a new CabinsManager with the specified player and view. Initializes the cabins list based on the player's shipboard and removes the cabin at coordinates (2, 3).
      Parameters:
      lightPlayer - the light player object representing the current player
      view - the view used to display messages to the user

  • Method Details

    • manageCabins

      public ArrayList<Tile> manageCabins(CrewType crewType)
      Manages the assignment of crew members to the cabins based on the selected crew type. It checks the alienability of each cabin and only allows compatible crew members to be placed in the cabins.
      Parameters:
      crewType - the type of crew member (e.g., human, purple alien, brown alien)
      Returns:
      the list of modified cabins after the crew placement
